chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from Muḥammad ibn Bazīʿ al-ʿAdawī, from Abū al-Ḥasan ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAwn al-Shāmī, who said:

ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Yaʿfūr narrated to me from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام concerning making up Salat al-Layl and al-Witr when a man misses them: should he make them up after Salat al-Fajr and after al-ʿAṣr? He said: There is no harm in that.

key_terms.الْوِتْرِ: the Witr prayer, the concluding unit of the night prayer
key_terms.بِذَلِكَ: with that act or ruling mentioned
key_terms.تَفُوتُ: is missed or passes by without being performed
key_terms.صَلَاةِ اللَّيْلِ: the night prayer performed as a recommended devotional act
key_terms.قَضَاءِ: making up an act of worship after its time has passed
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem or objection

ai.seo_question: Can missed Salat al-Layl and al-Witr be made up after Fajr or after ʿAṣr?
ai.summary: This hadith states that if a person misses Salat al-Layl and al-Witr, he may make them up after Salat al-Fajr and after al-ʿAṣr. It indicates the permissibility of qaḍāʾ for missed supererogatory prayers at these times.
